title: Login & lobby
subtitle: Customize the scenes, guidance and rules players encounter when joining.
login_description: Players enter the main lobby after authentication in the login space. Login scenes use Limbo schematics and do not directly support Paper world maps.
lobby_description: The main lobby provides server selection and supports map, plugin, experience, and building-permission configuration.
version_hint: Client compatibility depends on proxy plugins. Version changes need matching login, lobby and proxy support; this is the installation version, while the running version comes from each image.
stop_login: Stop the login space to read and save settings. New players cannot join during maintenance; start it again when finished.
stop_lobby: Stop the lobby to read and save settings. Back up its map before maintenance, then start it again when finished.
read_failed: Could not read settings: {{reason}}. Check felis-experience.json in the file manager.
saved: Saved. Settings apply on the next start or restart.
restart_requested: Restart requested. Follow the startup status above.
restart_hint: Restarting disconnects players in this space. Saved settings take effect after startup.
invalid_values: Check numeric ranges and selected options. Text is limited to 512 characters.
showWelcome: Send a welcome message on join
openMenuOnJoin: Open the server menu on join
teleportOnJoin: Return to world spawn on join
voidRescue: Return to spawn after a void fall
login_settings_hint: Binding codes and sign-in links are generated by the system. Chat prompts remain enabled. An explicitly configured login-timeout environment variable overrides this setting.
lobby_settings_hint: The welcome message includes a clickable server menu. Spawn comes from the map; use setworldspawn x y z in the lobby console to change it. Protection switches apply across the lobby. Builders keep their own game mode.
login_map_hint: Stop the login space, upload your scene as spawn.schem at the root, then start it. Adjust spawn coordinates in server.properties.
lobby_map_hint: Stop the lobby, upload and extract a world ZIP at the root. The world folder must directly contain level.dat. Set level-name in server.properties, then start it. Back up the existing map first.
plugins_hint: Upload plugin JARs and edit their configuration. Plugins must match the core and version of this space; bundled Felis plugins are refreshed from the image.
files_hint: Edit server properties, world settings and plugin data. Upload, extract, rename or download files. Authentication forwarding settings are maintained by the system.
console_hint: Read logs, run lobby commands, set world spawn or manage players.
login_console_hint: Read login runtime logs. Limbo has no RCON command channel; edit configuration in the file manager.
backups_hint: Back up before replacing maps, plugins or images; choose a saved backup to restore.
builder_hint: Granting felis.lobby.build allows the specified player to build in the lobby without enabling building for all players.
builder_running: Start the lobby before changing builder access.
discard_hint: Switching spaces discards unsaved changes. Cancel the switch and save the configuration to retain them.
appearance_description: Set the welcome message and server menu players see.
players_description: Choose join behavior, game mode and player protection.
world_description: Adjust time, weather and the lobby game rules.
loginBook_description: Edit the guidance players see in the login book.
apply_on_start: Save while running; settings take effect on the next start or restart
loading_settings: Loading settings. Editing will be available once loaded.
